craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta-vīra of time made; vyabhicāri vismayotsāha at cover-that-makes-time. Sanskrit-first: kalayantī EMENDATION WITH LIVE FORK per UNC — L3 chose emendation, L4 follows frozen L3 (fork lives in L0, never re-litigated in song); Mahākālī named whole. Rows: 2 (cover-without/time-within — outside spread, inside made), 1 (‘mine’ closes — Kālī claimed last). Close: ‘great Kālī, making all time, mine’. Rupture: period (cover spread, then time made — without, then within). Rejected: print reading — killed: argmap adjudicated (recorded); re-litigating fork — killed: fork lives in L0. Read aloud: CALLED-man-i-fes-TA-tion, KNOW-ing — SE-quence-LESS, FROM-void's-STEP MERGED with-OUT — … GREAT-kā-LĪ, MA-king-ALL-time, MINE.

lines: Called manifestation, knowing — sequenceless, from void's step merged without —
spreading sheer as cover. Then within, rush melted, sequence-free: great Kālī, making all time, mine.
l4.sanskrit_cite: prakāśākhyā saṃvit kramavirahitā | mahākālī seyaṃ mama kalayatāṃ kālam akhilam

reads_against.argmap: How does cover spread, and time get made? → Cover spread outside; time made within: Mahākālī.
c1_essence: Cover spread without; time made within.
